business_summary: The Seima Holdings Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells food products, industrial materials, and floor mats in Japan. The company provides food products, such as spaghetti, soup, curry, pasta sauce, and retort products. It offers jute and kenaf products, hemp bags, sandbags, binder string, linen thread, wire interposed yarn, carpet backing, hemp rope, rope, heat-retaining sheet for composite materials, Rivet bag, Hessian bag, Tamaito thread, and other PE/PP bags, as well as industrial materials, such as plastic bags; and heavy packaging paper bag, kraft paper bags, easy-open bag, sewing bag, double-stitched bags, one-side stitched bag, bag for rice and wheat, rice inspection bag, PV bag, BAX bag, PE products, PP products, flexible container, cardboard products, civil engineering materials, stretch film, bag-making materials, and other transport materials. In addition, the company provides car mats, including tufted carpet, hook drag, rubber mats, resin mats, etc. It offers its food products under the Volcano brand. The company was formerly known as The Nihon Seima Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to The Seima Holdings Co., Ltd.in October 2026. The Seima Holdings Co., Ltd was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Tonami, Japan.
